name: Shepit u lisi
source:
A group of friends meets to tell scary stories. But are these tales really so unique? Learn the consequences of making noise in the forest.

[From [url=https://sunrim.itch.io/whispers-in-the-forest]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一群好友聚在一起轮流讲鬼故事。然而这些怪谈真的只是凭空杜撰的奇闻吗？亲自领教在森林里大声喧哗会招致怎样的后果吧。

[摘自[url=https://sunrim.itch.io/whispers-in-the-forest]itch.io[/url]]
